messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

AI data center infrastructure is described around Connectivity, Power, and Resilience [15].
The data center connectivity portfolio includes high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection [1].
High-speed electrical connectivity includes 224 Gb/s PAM4, 224G/lane PAM4, 448G connector solutions, and OSFP cable assemblies up to 224G/lane PAM4 and 1.6T aggregate bandwidth [8].
Optical and fiber connectivity includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels, 1.6T OSFP transceivers, co-packaged optics, and pre-integrated fiber deployment [2].
Power and cooling connectivity includes high-current busbar connectors, 60 A AC input assemblies, +54V M-CRPS assemblies, cold plate and cage assemblies, coolant leak detection, and liquid cooling quick disconnects [3].
CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [17].
CMX500 supports NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, 802.11be, 802.11bn, 2x2 MIMO, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [17].
CMX500 is positioned for Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling testing under real-world conditions, including RF TX/RX characteristics, MLO-related multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [33].
CMX500 is also described for 5G/WLAN interworking, WLAN offloading, Voice over WLAN handover, N3IWF, and POLQA voice quality measurement [34].
CMW290 supports mobile station testing for GSM, NB-IoT, WCDMA, LTE, TD-SCDMA, CDMA2000, and NR Sub-6GHz in the cited data sheet [49].
CMW290 specifications apply to 40/80 MHz bandwidth units and 160 MHz bandwidth units, unless otherwise stated [50].
CMW290 options include NR Sub-6GHz RF analyzer and carrier aggregation options, plus LTE, NB-IoT, WCDMA, GSM, TD-SCDMA, and CDMA2000 waveform, analyzer, and signaling options [47].
CMP180 is positioned as a production radio communication tester for wireless communication device testing [55].
WLAN production RF measurements are described as non-signaling mode measurements to save time [35].
CMP180 supports Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [35].
CMP180 can verify a 480 MHz WLAN waveform in loopback mode, but that waveform is only described as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn candidate [35].
CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing [35].
Two CMP180 instruments can be combined for four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [35].
CMP180 specifications list 802.11be analyzer and generator support at 160 MHz and 320 MHz bandwidths [54].
CMP180 frequency range can extend from 6 GHz to 8 GHz with R&S CMP-K168, and IF bandwidth can reach 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185 under the stated hardware condition [56].
CMP180 measurement options include WLAN 802.11be SISO, WLAN true MIMO 2x2 and 4x4, WLAN true MIMO 5x5 and 6x6, NR FR1 single carrier, NR FR1 multi-carrier, and NR FR1 MIMO [57][58].
【推論】For wireless devices used around those environments, signaling testers need newer WLAN/cellular signaling, multi-RF-chain, interworking, throughput, PER, BLER, fading, and AWGN capability rather than only legacy callbox capability.[17][33][34][38]
【推論】For production non-signaling testing of such wireless devices, CMP-class capability aligns better with wider bandwidth, higher frequency, many RF ports, and MIMO scaling, while CMW290 remains limited to the cited 40/80 MHz and 160 MHz CMW scope.[35][49][50][56][57]

[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 是 [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 呈現的 portfolio 視角：把 AI / data center 的 high-speed electrical interconnect、optical interconnect、fiber deployment、rack power distribution、busbar、liquid cooling 與 leak detection 放在同一張 data center connectivity brochure 中。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Optical 與 fiber connectivity
- [[Amphenol XPO-LPO]] — 來源稱其以 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels，面向 AI scale-up deployments。
- [[1.6T OSFP Transceivers]] — 來源稱 Amphenol 200G/lane optical modules support DR4、FR4、2×DR4、2×FR4、AOC、breakout AOC configurations with LC or MPO ports。
- [[Amphenol Co-packaged Optics]] — 來源稱 Amphenol offers an architecture from high-density electrical interposer to linear optical conversion module to fiber plant。
- [[LEAP On-Board Transceiver]] — 來源稱其為 12-channel duplex optical transceiver，up to 25Gbps per channel，300Gbps cumulative on multi-mode fiber。
- [[300G CXP2 Active Optical Cable]] — 來源稱 CXP2 to CXP2 AOC provides cost-effective plug and play cabling solution，delivers high hardware faceplate port density among existing SFF industry standards。
- [[CommScope Rapid Fiber Connect Platform]] — 來源稱其 simplifies and accelerates AI scaling by pre-integrating optics off-site and reducing on-site fiber connections。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Power 與 cooling connectivity
- [[Amphenol BarKlip I-O products]] / [[BarKlip Busbar Connectors]] — 來源稱其 distribute high-current power between busbars、cables and circuit boards，適用 power-dense data centers、OCP rack and power solutions。
- [[60 A Universal AC Input Connector and Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱其 meet 2OU power distribution architecture standards，將 power 從 busway routing 到 power shelf。
- [[M-CRPS +54V Connectors and Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱其 meet OCP M-CRPS power supply input specifications。
- [[PwrBlade ULTRA HD+ Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 Cable-to-Board serves as high-power I/O cable configuration in a low-profile design。
- [[OSFP-RHS 224G Cold Plate and Cage Assembly]] — 來源稱其 optimizes port thermal efficiency and reliability，meeting MSA requirements，並提供 one-step press assembly。
- [[Amphenol Liquid Cooling Leakage Detection Sensor Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 detects coolant leaks and ensures system reliability。
- [[Liquid Cooling Quick Disconnect Connectors]] — 來源稱其用於 high-efficiency thermal management。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › 相關來源
- [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] — 來源未標示正式日期、raw converted 2026-09-17 的 Amphenol full-spectrum data center connectivity brochure。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › 與既有概念的關係
- [[Data center server 高速互連產品組合]] 偏向 data center server interconnect portfolio 的分類表；[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 更強調 full-spectrum：electrical interconnect + optical + fiber + power + cooling。
- [[Compute tray component solutions]] 偏向 compute tray connectors、cables、power connector、busbar 與 backplane interconnect；本頁納入 optical transceiver、CPO、fiber deployment 與 liquid cooling。
- [[高速伺服器儲存互連]] 可連接本頁中的 [[Mini Cool Edge IO]]、[[Cool Express Link]]、[[Direct Attached Copper Cables]]、[[PCIe CEM 7 Connectors]] 與 storage / EDSFF 類產品。
- [[CPO]]、[[Optical I-O]]、[[Near-Packaged Optics]] 可連接本頁的 [[Amphenol Co-packaged Optics]] 與 [[LEAP On-Board Transceiver]]，但本來源不是技術標準或市場採用證據。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › 使用限制
- [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 未標示正式日期；所有產品能力、規格數字與 marketing claim 需標示來源日期缺口。
- 來源是供應商 brochure，不是第三方市場報告；不可用來推論市占率、排名、客戶導入、採購關係或出貨量。
- 來源未提供 datasheet 版次、order number、合規證書或測試條件；224G、448G、1.6T、300G、60A、+54V、60 contacts、0.6mm pitch 等數字只能作為來源文字摘錄。
- PDF 轉檔為 lossy derivative；欄位串接與 OCR 風險需回看原始 PDF。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › 底部圖上產品清單
來源底部再以清單列出多個 electrical interconnect / memory / card edge / cable connector 類別，包括 [[SOCAMM and LPCAMM CAMM2 Connectors]]、[[CompacLink PCIe Gen 6 Compression Board-to-Board Connectors]]、[[Mini Cool Edge IO]] / [[Multi-Trak]]、[[Titen]]、[[Cool Express Link]]、[[DDR5 and Next Gen Memory Connector]]、[[Double & Single Density Mini Cool Edge]]、[[U.2 SFF8639]]、[[PCIe CEM 7 Connectors]] 與 [[Direct Attached PCIe CEM Cable Connectors]]。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › High-speed electrical connectivity
- [[Amphenol OverPass Cable Systems]] — 來源稱其 enable high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to end-points across the system。
- [[ExtremePort OSFP Connectors]] — 來源稱 connectors and cages have 60 contacts per port、0.6 mm pitch，並 optimized for signal integrity、thermal management and multi-lane pluggable architecture。
- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems。
- [[OSFP Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱 OSFP cable assemblies compatible with 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4，deliver aggregate bandwidths of 200G、400G、800G and 1.6T per cable assembly，available in Passive and Active variants。
- [[Sentry HD High-Speed Backplane Connector]] — 來源稱其是 next-generation high-speed backplane connector platform。
- [[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] — 來源稱其 designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。

Optical and fiber connectivity includes 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels, 1.6T OSFP transceivers, co-packaged optics, and pre-integrated fiber deployment [2].
Power and cooling connectivity includes high-current busbar connectors, 60 A AC input assemblies, +54V M-CRPS assemblies, cold plate and cage assemblies, coolant leak detection, and liquid cooling quick disconnects [3].
CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD [17].
CMX500 supports NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, 802.11be, 802.11bn, 2x2 MIMO, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, and PER measurement [17].
CMX500 is positioned for Wi‑Fi 7 R&D signaling testing under real-world conditions, including RF TX/RX characteristics, MLO-related multiple RF chains, 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [33].
CMX500 is also described for 5G/WLAN interworking, WLAN offloading, Voice over WLAN handover, N3IWF, and POLQA voice quality measurement [34].
CMW290 supports mobile station testing for GSM, NB-IoT, WCDMA, LTE, TD-SCDMA, CDMA2000, and NR Sub-6GHz in the cited data sheet [49].
CMW290 specifications apply to 40/80 MHz bandwidth units and 160 MHz bandwidth units, unless otherwise stated [50].
CMW290 options include NR Sub-6GHz RF analyzer and carrier aggregation options, plus LTE, NB-IoT, WCDMA, GSM, TD-SCDMA, and CDMA2000 waveform, analyzer, and signaling options [47].
CMP180 is positioned as a production radio communication tester for wireless communication device testing [55].
WLAN production RF measurements are described as non-signaling mode measurements to save time [35].
CMP180 supports Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [35].
CMP180 can verify a 480 MHz WLAN waveform in loopback mode, but that waveform is only described as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn candidate [35].
CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing [35].
Two CMP180 instruments can be combined for four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access point testing [35].
CMP180 specifications list 802.11be analyzer and generator support at 160 MHz and 320 MHz bandwidths [54].
CMP180 frequency range can extend from 6 GHz to 8 GHz with R&S CMP-K168, and IF bandwidth can reach 500 MHz with R&S CMP-K185 under the stated hardware condition [56].
CMP180 measurement options include WLAN 802.11be SISO, WLAN true MIMO 2x2 and 4x4, WLAN true MIMO 5x5 and 6x6, NR FR1 single carrier, NR FR1 multi-carrier, and NR FR1 MIMO [57][58].
【推論】For wireless devices used around those environments, signaling testers need newer WLAN/cellular signaling, multi-RF-chain, interworking, throughput, PER, BLER, fading, and AWGN capability rather than only legacy callbox capability.[17][33][34][38]
【推論】For production non-signaling testing of such wireless devices, CMP-class capability aligns better with wider bandwidth, higher frequency, many RF ports, and MIMO scaling, while CMW290 remains limited to the cited 40/80 MHz and 160 MHz CMW scope.[35][49][50][56][57]

依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：
